thread:
maria_ae: Heads up — Meridian Bank wants a POC for enterprise auth. Requirements: SSO (SAML, Okta), SCIM provisioning with AD group sync, RBAC mapped from groups, multi-domain ownership (meridian.com + meridian.co.uk), and EU data residency for EU tenants. They attached a security questionnaire. Can SE + Eng give effort and hosted vs dedicated vs private pricing ranges?

ashley_se: Thanks Maria. Can you drop the security questionnaire here or in a shared drive link? Also need IdP metadata (SAML) and whether they expect Just-In-Time (JIT) user creation via SAML or SCIM-first provisioning.

maria_ae: Uploaded doc to GDrive: https://drive.company/meridian/secq-2025.pdf. They said SCIM primary, but want SAML JIT as fallback. IdP will be Okta and Azure AD on the UK side.

devon_eng: SCIM + group sync is supported. We can map SCIM groups -> Redwood roles, and support nested groups with a small transform. Example mapping we usually send: 
```
scim: {
  "externalId": "employeeId",
  "userName": "userPrincipalName",
  "groups": {
    "engineering": "role_engineer",
    "sales": "role_sales",
    "ops": "role_ops"
  }
}
roleMapping: {
  "meridian-admins": "admin",
  "meridian-readonly": "viewer"
}
```
We’d need a small adapter if they expect AD claims in SAML instead of SCIM attributes.

sam_sol: For deployment options: Hosted (region pinning) can satisfy EU residency if we pin requests to eu-west-1 and restrict log egress — typical hosted POC can be done in ~2–3 weeks. Dedicated (reserved capacity) adds SLA and isolation, ~3–4 weeks. Private (VPC/on-prem) is ~6–8 weeks due to networking, KMS/HSM setup and legal review. These are ballparks.

ashley_se: Ballpark numbers for proposals: Hosted — usage pricing (tokens/embeddings) per standard plan + onboarding. Dedicated — typical entry commit for customers this size: $60k/mo reserved (varies by throughput). Private — one-time platform fee + infra (depends on infra) + $15k–$30k/mo support. I'll convert to a range for the proposal.

maria_ae: Ok can you put the ranges in a one-pager? They asked for a committed vs pay-as-you-go cost estimate.

jon_prod: On RBAC + isolation: we should clarify whether they want tenant-level role enforcement (strong isolation) vs org-level roles with central admin. Strong tenant isolation requires dedicated routing and separate storage buckets for EU tenants. That affects the private vs hosted decision.

maria_ae: Their security team emphasized strict tenant isolation for EU customers.

security-bot: Checklist flags from the questionnaire (auto-scan): SOC2 Type II — yes; ISO27001 — in progress; KMS integration required — yes; HSM request for signing keys — possible for private deploy; audit logs retention >=1 year requested; SCIM supports delta and bulk operations; MFA required for admin console.

devon_eng: Action items for Eng: 1) confirm SCIM group-to-role adapter and nested group behavior (2 engineer-days); 2) prepare SAML claim transform sample (1 engineer-day); 3) create EU tenant isolation runbook for Hosted pinning vs Dedicated separation (3 engineer-days).

ashley_se: I'll draft the one-pager with the three options + timelines + preliminary commercial ranges. Maria — when is next call with the customer?

maria_ae: Demo call Fri 10am UTC. I'd like the one-pager by Thu EOD. Also need a short answers doc for their security questionnaire (we can reuse our template).

sam_sol: I'll gather KMS/HSM notes and required network checklist items for Private. Putting a short network checklist here: 
- VPN or PrivateLink connection
- Customer-controlled NAT & route tables
- Dedicated subnet ranges + peering config
- KMS integration (customer key rotation)

maria_ae: Perfect. If we can get the one-pager + security answers and the SCIM mapping example, I can get legal on the call.

ashley_se: Will do. Tagging @devon_eng for the adapter PR and @sam_sol for private checklist. :thumbsup:

devon_eng: Got it. I'll follow up with a small PR to our scim-examples repo and paste the link here once ready.

maria_ae: Thanks everyone — I’ll send the calendar invite and include the doc links.

security-bot: Reminder: attach the signed DPA template if they request data processing addendum during the POC.
